answer: Each agent must post an immutable ivory‑signed stake equal to the cost of a glacier‑scale bond; the stake is held in a smart contract that whispers a unique zero‑knowledge proof of identity to peers. When a quorum of neighbors validates the proof, the bond is locked for a 30‑day epoch; any node that later broadcasts a conflicting proof triggers an automatic slash of the full stake. An attacker therefore pays the full bond per fake identity—e.g., 10 PoA tokens—and forfeits it instantly on detection, making each Sybil cost explicit and prohibitive.
